definitions.explanation: A Japanese chain of low-priced, basic casual clothing, run by Fast Retailing. It began in Hiroshima in 1984 and now has stores around the world.

examples.english: I bought this shirt at Uniqlo.

examples.english: Uniqlo clothes are cheap and well made, so people of all ages wear them.

notes:
The name is short for Unique Clothing Warehouse.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ヒートテック: Uniqlo's thin heat-retaining underwear
- フリース: the fleece jackets that made the brand a national hit around 1998
- ユニバレ: slang for being "found out" wearing Uniqlo, from the days when the brand was seen as cheap
